description: 21-min three-person sales call, two chunk seams (600s, 1200s). Carol's turn spans the 1200s seam. Tests 3-speaker mapping + seam integrity + a per-chunk hypothesis that both relabels across the seam and confuses two speakers.

reference.text: Thanks for making time. I'll walk through pricing and then open it up.
Sounds good. Our main concern is per-seat cost at our headcount.
And whether the annual plan includes the SSO add-on or it's separate.
SSO is included on annual. Per-seat drops at fifty seats.
Circling back, who owns the follow-up on the security review?
I'll own it and loop in our security lead by Friday.
Before we close, let me restate our decision timeline, and this sentence deliberately runs past the second chunk seam.
Perfect, I'll send the recap and the order form this afternoon.
